Why it's different

Typical encrypted IM vs. a physically-isolated pair

Most encrypted chat escrows your keys alongside your messages. Engine leaves a different shape in the breach: nothing but noise.

✕ Typical encrypted IM

  • Server forwards messages and escrows keys in the same trust zone
  • One database leak = full history including key material
  • Identity bound to phone / email, subpoena-able

✓ Engine × Vault

  • Keys live in an offline device; Engine is pure-memory, holds nothing
  • Relay is stateless — breach it and all you get is ciphertext
  • Identity is a self-owned signature, signable only by your offline safe
Capabilities

What you can actually do today.

E2E chat

ECDH agreement + AES-256-GCM with AAD-bound anti-replay, backed by an open audit library.

Groups & gating

Up to 200 members, invite codes and approval queues — moderation without a snooping server.

Pure memory

No Room, no SQLite, no DataStore. Kill the process and everything evaporates.

Spark economy

Fuel subsidy SPARK and emoji gifting keep a real economy running entirely on-chain-free.
